Known-truth recovery separates the planted condition-by-time target from collection time. The
AML longitudinal calibration control experiment uses the synthetic expression layer to assess
the declared condition target contrasts CM with CTL. Horizontal position is absolute loading
cosine with planted truth, with larger values indicating closer geometric recovery; Vertical
position is the batch-adjusted condition-by-time effect magnitude used for proposal ranking;
The red triangle is nominated PC2, which recovers the planted condition-by-time axis (absolute
cosine 0.995; effect magnitude 4.37); The black circle is PC1, which recovers the planted
collection-time axis (absolute cosine 0.999; effect magnitude 0.02). The analysis unit is a
complete synthetic mouse trajectory; the design is repeated-subject longitudinal with irregular
observation times; the estimand is the batch-adjusted standardized condition-by-time effect
magnitude; time is recorded as collection time in weeks; subjects are identified by mouse_id;
adjustment uses batch. Point positions summarize the discovery fit; 49 of 49 complete-subject
bootstrap refits completed the full assessment and are reported in the companion
identifiability audit. No acceptance threshold is applied. This disclosed synthetic calibration
control does not establish biological validity or independent acceptance.
